decisions.reason: Although it lacks a dedicated page, the firm has already invested in this product family and remains publicly associated with it, so escalation of commitment favors persistence.
Its promotion to a dedicated page in 2024 signals increased public commitment and visibility, making withdrawal unlikely under escalation logic.
The product remains on the website and part of the firm's committed range, so prior investment and responsibility lead management to continue it.
Award wins and a dedicated page make this product highly visible and central, so the firm is strongly committed to keeping it.
